children: TRON crosses a listing milestone as the first U.S. staked TRX spot ETF, ticker TRXS, begins trading on Cboe BZX. The fund holds at least 90% of its TRX in a staked state under normal conditions, rolls staking yield into NAV, charges a 1.10% sponsor fee, and operates with a 14-day TRON unfreeze window for redemptions.

The staking mandate links fund creation directly to staked TRX supply. Each new share creation pulls TRX off the liquid market and into the staking set, since the portfolio must stay at least 90% staked. Yield accrues inside NAV, so holders track price and staking return through one regulated U.S. listing rather than managing wallets or validators.
The 14-day unfreeze window is the mechanical constraint to watch. Redemptions clear only after unstaked TRX exits TRON's waiting period, so creation flows shape staked supply faster than outflows do.
⚡️ The first U.S. staked TRX spot ETF lists today.
This is not a price wrapper. Staking yield is written into NAV.
